description: This file defines a service class 'OutputOrganizationsEventTypesService' for handling organization-specific event type responses, including fetching hosts, transforming metadata, and preparing response data for event types within an organization context.

classes.name: OutputOrganizationsEventTypesService
classes.description: Service class for managing organization-specific event type responses, including host retrieval and metadata transformation.

methods.name: getResponseTeamEventType
methods.description: Generates a response object for a given event type, including host info, team info, and metadata.

methods.name: getResponseSchedulingType
methods.description: Converts SchedulingType enum to string representation.

methods.name: getManagedEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Fetches hosts for a managed event type by retrieving child event types and associated user info.

methods.name: getNonManagedEventTypeHosts
methods.description: Transforms host data into response format, including handling of mandatory and priority fields for round robin scheduling.

methods.name: transformEmailSettings
methods.description: Transforms email disablement metadata into email settings object.
